what: RECORDING: a fleet action fought by the computer on both sides for the 3D scene to replay (tools/sea-record). Not a booked result: the campaign never reads it. Each view carries the zones only where they changed since the view before, and a piece's still fields (kind, name, nat, figures0, w; extra.cls, ships0, fleet) only the first time it shows.
